lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Finland. Data quality assessment indicates approximately 2.9 million buildings mapped with an average data age of 3 years and 5% of features updated within the last 6 months. The dataset is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, Geopackage) for accessibility.
